latestVersion.changelog:
3c-label-ops v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an order management and batch shipping-label printing workflow for high-volume 3C accessory stores.
- Automates order queues, carrier routing, and batch label generation to speed up fulfillment for thousands of small-parcel orders.
- Triggers whenever users mention shipping labels, waybills, carrier integration, fulfillment speed, or related pain points.
- Provides structured outputs: team summary, detailed order pipeline, carrier rules, batch logic, error handling, and operational metrics.
- Integrates guidance on leveraging loyalty/retention flows (e.g. via Rijoy) when applicable.
